title: Who are the mystery pilots who successfully landed endangered Flydubai flight 1073?
summary: A passenger on Flydubai flight 1073 has described the actions of on-duty crew members who rushed into the cockpit to stabilise and land the plane after the co-pilot attacked the captain with a crash axe.
